title: HAZBRA: a climate hazard dataset for Brazil with observed and projected indicators at grid and municipal scale
description:
HAZBRA is a climate hazard dataset for Brazil: 16 indicators of extreme rainfall, drought, heat and compound hazards, observed and projected, on regular grids (NetCDF4) and for all 5,570 municipalities (Parquet, IBGE 2024 codes). The full user guide is README.md in this record.

Contents

  • Observed (CHIRPS 0.05°, MERGE 0.1°, BR-DWGD/XAVIER 0.1°): climatologies (1981–2010; MERGE 2001–2020), annual time series, Hamed & Rao modified Mann–Kendall trends with Sen's slope (1981–2023; MERGE 2001–2023), GEV return levels for 5–100 years and GEV parameters.
  • Projected (19 bias-corrected CMIP6 models of CLIMBRA, 0.25°): climatologies and return levels at the reference period (1981–2010) and at global warming levels of +1.5, +2 and +3 °C (30-year SSP5-8.5 windows); per-model and ensemble (mean, median, P10, P90) values; changes in absolute and % terms with model agreement (≥66 % of models); return-period shifts and probability ratios of historical 5–100-year events; delta-change projections on each observational baseline; annual time series 1980–2100 under SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5.
  • Municipal: area-weighted aggregation of all observational and ensemble products (mean, std, min, max, method), with robustness and trend-significance shares.
  • Quality control: flags and original values of every return-level cell modified by the outlier filter.

Indicators

Rainfall: Rx1day, Rx5day, CWD, PRCPTOT, seasonal precipitation. Drought: CDD, seasonal CDD, SPI-3 (seasonal minimum), SPI-6 (annual minimum). Heat: TXx, TNn, frost spell (TN < 6 °C), WSDI. Compound: Heat Index (mean, maximum, days per NOAA class), Fire Weather Index (mean, maximum, days per danger class), hot–dry days.

Files

  • README.md – user guide (indicators, periods, file naming, variables, dimensions, examples, limitations)
  • README_municipalities.md – municipal tables in detail
  • netcdf_CLIMBRA_<Hazard>.zip, netcdf_Observational_<Hazard>.zip – gridded products (Hazard = Rainfall, Drought, Heat, Compound)
  • municipalities_CLIMBRA_<Hazard>.zip, municipalities_Observations_<Hazard>.zip – municipal tables
  • municipalities_geometry.zip, municipalities_weights.zip, netcdf_outliers.zip, MD5SUMS.txt

Unpack all zips in one folder to rebuild the tree netcdf/ and municipalities/.

Quick start

import xarray as xr
ds = xr.open_dataset("netcdf/CLIMBRA/Rainfall/Rx5day/ensemble/ensemble_anomaly_return_period.nc")
change = ds["Rx5day_anom_perc"].sel(ensemble="median", GWL="2", return_period=25)   # % change of the 25-yr event at +2 °C

Notes

The source datasets (CHIRPS, MERGE, BR-DWGD, CLIMBRA) are not redistributed; please also cite them. Processing code: github.com/Luisgcattelan/HAZBRA (doi:10.5281/zenodo.24319623).
